title: SOS rate limiter leaks memory for one-shot sources
description: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:102-121/137/165-172 (pre-existing, found during r7hs review): _prune_old_requests only runs inside evaluate_rate_limit for the source currently being evaluated and deletes an entry only when that source's own timestamps age out AND it queries again. An attacker generating fresh keypairs (one activation each; first request always passes) grows _request_times/_period_start unboundedly on a long-lived node. Add global pruning (periodic sweep or size cap with LRU eviction).
